body:
Dispatch records supply an owned scratch root and close command; close retains cited public evidence, compresses files above 256 KiB, saves original SHA-256 digests, and removes scratch worktrees with uncommitted-file counts. Idle task output prompts ended/merged/archived cleanup. Roots distinguish repositories, clones and workflows and refuse unowned reuse. Worker instructions exclude all private-repository evidence, secrets and personal data, retaining a reproduction command instead.

The Codex repair lets a later validation or role dispatch name its own scratch root before the next number is selected. Evidence checks all collisions and saved gzip/digests before mutation, then saves original digests before compression so a later write failure can be retried. Regression tests reproduce both reported findings and sibling failure sites on the prior code.

Candidate c429ab1815a5fc5507056ee54f8005be024e1e69 includes two-parent merge 2f454b7bd of main abe8c08ea2716e5f1c046823082e122759703b87. The watcher keeps both scratch cleanup and main's extension reader/explicit observer README; its combined detached-state test proves both, including cleanup with learn disabled. No rebase, amended commit, version edit or product push.

Validation: all 28 CI Python entry points are covered, with 1,438 unittest passes, 10 explicit opt-in skips and zero failures, plus two passing native integration programs. The selected set uses the watcher entry rerun after a canonical-path test expectation fix; coverage-binding.json proves all other package bytes unchanged. Four-step fresh-bash acceptance passes; 20 mutations rejected. Skill lint, assigned-package ADR lint, fresh-ref number guards, design surfaces and comment ratio pass (0.8%, maximum 5%). Raw alias failures, exact source binding, skips, sibling audit and merge-hunk resolution are retained on the public task state branch. Inputs are public/synthetic only.

FO owns publication, RoboRev/Codex/engineering review and validation-3 under Captain amendment 3. Hosted CI and post-release adopter acceptance remain unproven. CI cost per PR not measured; triggers unchanged.

RoboRev on c429ab181 (run by FO): one High finding, job 1815, that archived evidence has no check that it is public; waived for this PR by the Captain on 2026-11-13 and carried by a backlog task.
